wholePhysicalScope: The named Toronto City Hall building relation and four architectural footprints, the exact 2018 Qualla photograph, city and transit heritage descriptions, and independently sampled terrain.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the podium, two uneven crescent towers, council chamber and ceremonial ramp. Near levels add glass divisions and concrete ribs.
limitations: The model represents the April 2018 City Hall exterior with the two curved tower slabs, podium, council chamber and ceremonial ramp. The wider square and adjacent structures are outside scope.

The footprint and 79.4 and 99.5 metre roof heights follow the named map record. Council chamber construction and roof profile, the podium’s paving and garden details, and the exact ceremonial ramp section remain approximate.
The original regional elevation model provides the surrounding ground. It does not resolve the podium floor, plaza paving or individual thresholds.
